name: scout-ndpst
description: Monorepo SCOUT-NDPST : plateforme d'une paroisse — API NestJS et application Next.js (site public et gestion du groupe scout).

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @scout/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @scout/shared" "npm run dev -w @scout/api" "npm run dev -w @scout/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @scout/shared && npm run build -w @scout/api -w @scout/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @scout/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @scout/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
